resources.string: Settings grouped by topic. Quick guide and version history now live under About StartPerTap.
Ambulance icon without a label. Optional emergency information closes after four seconds.
Added an optional emergency screen at startup. It can be enabled in PIN-protected settings.
Added the emergency window with an address, up to three contacts and a link to a signed advance directive PDF. Tapping a contact opens the dialer.
Documented release with up to 36 customizable tiles, offline media and PIN-protected editing.
Red background for the emergency icon
The emergency icon has a transparent background by default. A red background can be enabled in settings.
Settings sections start collapsed and use distinct pastel colors and rounded buttons.
